author: quality-assurance
text: Independent QA found an AC4/AC7 defect: clarification.py validate marks a multi-question unresolved event resolved after the first mapped response. With two previously answered questions, an ambiguous utterance changing both and a mapping for only Q001 produces unresolved=[] while Q002 retains its old effective answer; validate_proposal then reports ready_for_human_review. Reproduction: files/agent-invocations/7884fdbd-541a-4c98-b6b3-588bba730615/edge_review.py. The dialogue convention requires holding until all mappings settle. Independent source package suite: 22 tests passed; this scenario is not covered. Source only; installed package unchanged.
